Kuber · Web v1

Web v1 · Image mockups

One mockup per feature page slug, Kuber Signature light and dark, all from the M3 app screens in this project with one sample dataset (Gaurav, Your Bank, Rewards Card, July net +₹45,200). One frame: 376 × 796, bezel #1B1B1F, radius 40 outer / 32 screen. Exported at 2x to web-v1/mockups/<slug>-light.png and -dark.png (752 × 1592). Site ships them as AVIF/WebP at fixed width and height.
